0022600146.text: The Memphis Grizzlies (4-0) visit the Portland Trail Blazers (2-0) for Memphis's fifth game of the season, with the Grizzlies 2nd in the Southwest and 5th in the West, while Portland is 2nd in the Northwest, 1 game back, and 4th in the West. Portland will be without Chris Youngblood, who is out with ankle soreness, and Shaedon Sharpe, who is out following knee surgery, and Memphis has no players listed as unavailable. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Grizzlies lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, with the most recent meeting a 122-114 defeat in Memphis on March 4, 2026.
